integrity: The decomposition follows from exact Kronecker identities and permutation equivalence. A standalone verifier reconstructs a published \([12,2,8]\) example, checks the matrix equivalence, transports all \(64\) lifted codewords through the coordinate permutation, and verifies the Tanner-component decomposition.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the source's uniform single-permutation Kronecker construction \(A\otimes P\). It does not classify the position-dependent permutation-block lifts from the source's Remark 3.4 and does not assert a simultaneous-vertex decomposition of the associated directed graph.
title: Uniform Kronecker permutation lifts are direct sums of the base LDPC code
